title: [cpuinfo] warnings: The following EXEs were found in.... then errors: but seems to install

labels.name: category:port-bug
labels.description: The issue is with a library, which is something the port should already support

body:
**Describe the bug**
On windows, maybe others also, vcpkg needs to check when a `statically linked only` port is compiled/linked under dynamic triplets (in this case `x64-windows`) to see if a `tools` feature is selected and therefor may contain the tool executables (in this case `cpuid-dump.exe`) and not produce warnings/errors about statically linked ports have EXEs in .\bin and .\debug\bin directories.

**Environment**
- OS: [Windows 11 22H2 Version [10.0.22621.963]]
- Compiler: VS 2022
   - Visual Studio Community 2022 Version: [17.4.3]  VS Tools Version: [14.34.31933] 
   - Microsoft (R) C/C++ Optimizing Compiler Version [19.34.31937] for x64 
- Vcpkg-Tool Version [2022-12-18-7748e2f4ebe7656de6e46aa2539b15ba8c906952]  (latest as of 21:00 EST 2022-12-19)

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior: 

`triplet = x64-windows`
1. .\vcpkg.exe install --recurse --keep-going --clean-buildtrees-after-build --clean-packages-after-build --no-print-usage cpuinfo[core,tools]
2. See error:
>Installing 1/12 cpuinfo:x64-windows...
>Building cpuinfo[core,tools]:x64-windows...
>-- Note: cpuinfo only supports static library linkage. Building static library.
>-- Using cached pytorch-cpuinfo-5e63739504f0f8e18e941bd63b2d6d42536c7d90.tar.gz.
>-- Extracting source D:/vcpkg-downloads/pytorch-cpuinfo-5e63739504f0f8e18e941bd63b2d6d42536c7d90.tar.gz
>-- Using source at D:/vcpkg/buildtrees/cpuinfo/src/42536c7d90-2a15ca16d1.clean
>-- Configuring x64-windows
>-- Building x64-windows-dbg
>-- Building x64-windows-rel
>-- Fixing pkgconfig file: D:/vcpkg/packages/cpuinfo_x64-windows/lib/pkgconfig/libcpuinfo.pc
>-- Using cached msys-mingw-w64-i686-pkg-config-0.29.2-3-any.pkg.tar.zst.
>-- Using cached msys-mingw-w64-i686-libwinpthread-git-9.0.0.6373.5be8fcd83-1-any.pkg.tar.zst.
>-- Using msys root at D:/vcpkg-downloads/tools/msys2/9a1ec3f33446b195
>-- Fixing pkgconfig file: D:/vcpkg/packages/cpuinfo_x64-windows/debug/lib/pkgconfig/libcpuinfo.pc
>-- Installing: D:/vcpkg/packages/cpuinfo_x64-windows/share/cpuinfo/copyright
>-- Performing post-build validation
>warning: The following EXEs were found in /bin or /debug/bin. EXEs are not valid distribution targets.
>
>    D:/vcpkg/packages/cpuinfo_x64-windows/bin/cpuid-dump.exe
>
>warning: The following EXEs were found in /bin or /debug/bin. EXEs are not valid distribution targets.
>
>    D:/vcpkg/packages/cpuinfo_x64-windows/debug/bin/cpuid-dump.exe
>
>warning: There should be no bin\ directory in a static build, but D:\vcpkg\packages\cpuinfo_x64-windows\bin is present.
>warning: There should be no debug\bin\ directory in a static build, but D:\vcpkg\packages\cpuinfo_x64-windows\debug\bin is present.
>warning: If the creation of bin\ and/or debug\bin\ cannot be disabled, use this in the portfile to remove them
>    if(VCPKG_LIBRARY_LINKAGE STREQUAL "static")
>        file(REMOVE_RECURSE "${CURRENT_PACKAGES_DIR}/bin" "${CURRENT_PACKAGES_DIR}/debug/bin")
>    endif()
>
>error: Found 3 post-build check problem(s). To submit these ports to curated catalogs, please first correct the portfile: D:\vcpkg\ports\cpuinfo\portfile.cmake
>Elapsed time to handle cpuinfo:x64-windows: 8.954 s
>

**Expected behavior**
No Warning or Error message produced when a statically linked port is compiled under a dynamic triplet and the port contains a `tools` feature.

**Failure logs**

**Additional context**
Add any other context about the problem here.
The port with cpuinfo[core,tools] seems to be installed properly and shows on `.\vcpkg.exe list cpuinfo`:
>cpuinfo:x64-windows                               2022-07-19#1        CPU INFOrmation library (x86/x86-64/ARM/ARM64, L...
>cpuinfo[tools]:x64-windows                                                    Build cpuinfo command-line tools
